verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS registrar that also ships an API and MCP server, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions a telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out for the site, the API or the MCP server. The privacy evidence covers WHOIS contact hiding, which is a different control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
